title: Bugged Seattle hotel meeting and the journalist's death
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Bugged Seattle hotel meeting and the journalist's death, about 1947 at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> Turns out the place was bugged. Turns out a local journalist got a tape of the entire meeting and he dies shortly thereafter. Right.

plain: Peter Levenda, a researcher and author, said this on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels. He tells of a 1947 meeting in a Seattle hotel tied to two men from that year's flying saucer stories, Kenneth Arnold and Fred Crisman, and he says the room was bugged. According to Levenda, a local journalist got a tape of the whole meeting and died soon after, which, if true, would suggest someone wanted that recording kept quiet.
